items.question: Does the Kestrel storage agreement have a fixed end date?
items.answer:
The Kestrel storage agreement does not have a fixed end date. Clause 5.1 of the agreement states, "This Agreement continues until terminated" [1].

There is no mention of a fixed end date in the agreement or in the amendment. The amendment only modifies the monthly storage fee and the effective date of the amendment [7][8].

items.question: Which terms of the storage agreement remain in force after Amendment No. 1?
items.answer:
Amendment No. 1 to the Kestrel storage agreement states that "All other terms of the Storage Services Agreement remain in force" [1].

The Kestrel Storage Services Agreement includes terms such as the services provided, fees, and term and termination. The storage services are described in Clause 1.1, which states that the Provider will store the Client's archived equipment at its Brookfield facility [3]. The fees are outlined in Clause 3.1, which originally stated that the Client shall pay a monthly storage fee of EUR 4,000 [3]. The term and termination clause, Clause 5.1, states that the Agreement continues until terminated [3].

Amendment No. 1 changes the fee in Clause 3.1 to EUR 4,600 [7]. However, all other terms of the Storage Services Agreement remain in force.
